unhealthyPodEvictionPolicy.description: Whether unhealthy pods may be evicted regardless of the budget. Leave empty to use the Kubernetes default.

enabled.description: Create this Pod Disruption Budget when true. Accepts a Helm `tpl` string that renders to `true` or `false`.

namespace.description: Namespace to create this object in. Overrides the chart-wide `namespace` and `global.namespace`.

labels.description: Additional labels for Pod Disruption Budget

annotationsList.description: Additional annotations as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the annotations

labelsList.description: Additional labels as a list of name and value pairs, merged into the labels

annotations.description: Additional annotations for Pod Disruption Budget

minAvailable.description: Minimum number or percentage of pods that must stay available during a disruption. Do not combine with `maxUnavailable`.

maxUnavailable.description: Maximum number or percentage of pods that may be unavailable during a disruption. Do not combine with `minAvailable`.

targetSelector.description: Name of the workload the budget applies to. Defaults to the primary workload.

customLabels.description: Labels used to select the pods covered by the budget, replacing the automatically selected pod labels.

description: Pod Disruption Budgets, keyed by name.
